## 13. Glossary

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **AuriOS** | The application — a Windows desktop AI assistant for automated developer software installation |
| **Orchestrator** | `backend/core/orchestrator.py` — the coordinator class that runs the 7-stage agent pipeline in sequence |
| **ReAct pattern** | Reasoning + Acting loop: `reason()` (decide what to do) → `act()` (do it) → `observe()` (interpret result). All agents follow this structure |
| **preset** | A named bundle of software + pip packages (e.g. `python_ml` = Python + VS Code + Git + TensorFlow etc.) |
| **slug** | Short, alphanumeric software identifier used as primary key in the catalog (e.g. `"python"`, `"nodejs"`, `"7zip"`) |
| **task** | A UUID-identified installation run stored in the `tasks` DB table, with status/progress tracked in real time |
| **task_manager** | Singleton `TaskManager` instance in `backend/core/task_manager.py` — the single point of DB writes for task state |
| **Ollama** | Local LLM server running llama3.2:3b on `localhost:11434` — used for natural-language responses |
| **llama3.2:3b** | Meta's 3-billion-parameter LLaMA 3.2 model — runs locally, no cloud needed |
| **Touch Point 1** | Pre-install LLM call (`_llm_explain_preset`) — explains tools and asks for confirmation |
| **Touch Point 2** | Post-install LLM call (`_llm_completion_message`) — generates helpful "here's how to start" message |
| **intent** | The classified meaning of a user message (e.g. `"single_software"`, `"python_ml"`, `"general_chat"`) |
| **canned response** | A hardcoded reply for common phrases (hi, thanks, bye, etc.) that bypasses Ollama entirely |
| **rule-based classifier** | The regex-based intent detection in `_rule_based_intent()` — deterministic, no LLM needed |
| **WAL mode** | SQLite Write-Ahead Log — allows concurrent reads during writes, critical for WebSocket polling during installs |
| **context bridge** | Electron's `contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld` — the security boundary between Node.js (preload) and browser renderer |
| **app://** | Custom Electron protocol scheme — treats renderer pages as a secure origin, enabling Web Speech API |
| **DetectionAgent** | Scans PATH, filesystem, and Windows registry to determine which software is installed |
| **DownloadAgent** | Downloads installer binaries from GitHub Releases with streaming progress and retry |
| **InstallAgent** | Runs `.exe`/`.msi` installers silently, with winget and choco fallbacks |
| **ConfigureAgent** | Updates Windows PATH via `winreg` and installs pip packages |
| **ValidationAgent** | Re-runs DetectionAgent up to 30 times to confirm installed software is detectable |
| **EnvironmentAgent** | Creates project directory structure and Python virtual environment |
| **repo_sync** | `backend/utils/repo_sync.py` — fetches the GitHub Releases software catalog and caches it in SQLite |
| **_FALLBACK_CATALOG** | Hardcoded catalog in `repo_sync.py` used when GitHub API is unreachable — contains direct download URLs for 12 software packages |
| **PRETTY** | Dict mapping software slug → human display name, shared between `orchestrator.py` and `server.py` |
| **PRESET_CONFIGS** | Dict mapping preset name → `{software: list, pip_packages: list}` — defines what gets installed per preset |
| **CUSTOM_FLAGS** | Dict in `install_agent.py` mapping exact installer filenames → silent install CLI flags |
| **WINGET_IDS** | Dict in `install_agent.py` mapping software slug → winget package ID for fallback installation |
| **System Admin** | Special admin account `admin@jarvis.local` — credentials stored in `backend/.env`, not in users table |
| **admin_session** | Session token for System Admin, stored in `preferences` table (not `sessions`), prefixed `"admin_"` |
| **Fernet** | Symmetric encryption algorithm (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) from Python `cryptography` library — used for GitHub PAT storage |
| **WM_SETTINGCHANGE** | Windows message (0x001A) broadcast by ConfigureAgent after PATH update, so running processes reload environment without restart |
| **DETACHED_PROCESS** | `subprocess.DETACHED_PROCESS` flag — used when launching GUI apps post-install so they survive if the installer exits |
| **is_simulated_host** | `True` on non-Windows or when `AURIOS_SIMULATE_INSTALL=1` — agents skip real operations and simulate success |
| **conversationManager** | Frontend JavaScript object (in `app.js`) managing conversation CRUD in `localStorage` |
| **progress panel** | Frontend UI component (`progress-panel.js`) showing 6 stage indicators, driven by WebSocket messages |
| **category intent** | When a user message matches a general tech category (ml, database, coding) rather than a specific software — triggers a clarifying question |
| **card prompt** | Clicking a template card on the dashboard submits its `data-prompt` attribute directly as a chat message |
| **ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH** | bcrypt hash of the System Admin password, stored in `backend/.env` — defaults to hash of `"Admin@1234"` on first run |
| **bcrypt** | Password hashing algorithm used for all user passwords and admin credentials — uses `bcrypt.gensalt()` for per-hash salt |
